sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: No Limit to Perfection - Part 6 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "It's one thing to handle a weapon, but a whole other thing to understand its strengths and weaknesses. Submachine guns, for example, perform best in the hands of a mobile fighter at close range. Don't try to make a weapon do something it's not meant for — you wouldn't slice bread with a fork, would you? So get out there and practice!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 2 enemies within 15 seconds while using a submachine gun 20 times

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- +300 Submachine Guns skill points
- 20 GP coins
- 1× Valuables crate (Rare)
